name: @troubastack/bake
description: TroubaStack bake worker (Node). The ONLY legitimate server-side JS runtime: core invokes it to render annotation overlays via @troubastack/ink for pixel-parity (I8). Emits self-contained flattened WebP (I12).
//build: Typecheck only while bake is a stub. bake compiles @troubastack/ink from source (see tsconfig paths), so an emitting build would also write a second compiled copy of ink into dist/ — a trap and an I8 smell. Switch to a real emit (project references, or a bundler) when bake() is implemented.
//deps: Intended (NOT installed — scaffold, no network): a Node canvas lib such as @napi-rs/canvas to give @troubastack/ink an OffscreenCanvas-like 2D context; a PDF rasterizer (MuPDF/pdfium/poppler) is invoked by CORE (06-tech-stack.md), which may run it as a sidecar — bake handles the overlay, core handles the page raster.
